Description: Multiple TEE Pairs with Intel SGX and AMD SEV Cross-Attestation for High TPS

KeyName.Description: Name of an existing EC2 KeyPair to enable SSH access
KeyName.ConstraintDescription: Must be the name of an existing EC2 KeyPair.

PairCount.Description: Number of TEE pairs to deploy (1-5)

Properties.GroupDescription: Security group for Intel SGX nodes
Security group for AMD SEV nodes

Properties.Description: Allow all traffic between TEE nodes in the mesh
Allow all traffic between TEE nodes in the mesh (reverse)
Allow all traffic between SGX nodes
Allow all traffic between SEV nodes

Fn::Join:
#!/bin/bash -xe
exec > >(tee /var/log/user-data.log|logger -t user-data -s 2>/dev/console) 2>&1
echo "Starting SGX node 1 setup"

# Update system
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y build-essential git cmake libssl-dev curl jq apache2

# Configure TEE environment
mkdir -p /opt/rhombus/tee
mkdir -p /opt/rhombus/mesh
cd /opt/rhombus/tee

# Configure TEE node
export TEE_TYPE="SGX"
export TEE_ID="sgx-node-1"
export REGION_ID="us-east-1"
export CROSS_ATTESTATION_ENABLED="true"
export MESH_ENABLED="true"

# Create node configuration
PUBLIC_IP=$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/public-ipv4)
PRIVATE_IP=$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/local-ipv4)
INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)

# Create mesh network configuration
cat > /opt/rhombus/mesh/node_info.json << EOF
{
  "node_type": "SGX",
  "node_id": "${INSTANCE_ID}",
  "node_index": 1,
  "public_ip": "${PUBLIC_IP}",
  "private_ip": "${PRIVATE_IP}",
  "port": 7070,
  "region": "us-east-1"
}
EOF

# Set up parameter validation for WebAssembly
mkdir -p /opt/rhombus/validation
cat > /opt/rhombus/validation/parameter_config.json << EOF
{
  "validation": {
    "length_prefixed": true,
    "direct_format": true,
    "max_size": 1024,
    "format_detection": true
  },
  "cross_attestation": {
    "enabled": true,
    "partner_type": "SEV",
    "verification_ms_target": 50
  }
}
EOF

# Install monitoring service
cat > /opt/rhombus/tee/status.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
IP=$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/public-ipv4)
ID=$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)
echo "{\"node_type\":\"SGX\",\"id\":\"$ID\",\"ip\":\"$IP\",\"status\":\"running\",\"timestamp\":\"$(date -u +\"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\")\"}">  /var/www/html/status.json
EOF
chmod +x /opt/rhombus/tee/status.sh

# Set up web server to expose status
echo '*/5 * * * * root /opt/rhombus/tee/status.sh' > /etc/cron.d/tee-status
systemctl enable apache2
systemctl restart apache2

# Write node info to publicly accessible location
mkdir -p /var/www/html
cp /opt/rhombus/mesh/node_info.json /var/www/html/
chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/html/

echo "SGX node 1 setup complete"
